messages:
Sam: quick sync for ZenForge cutover — can we list current blockers? I want to make sure owners/time estimates before EOD.
Aya: Carrier still needs a confirmed port schedule from ZenForge rack vendor. Waiting on confirmation, asked for ETA this morning.
Devon: FYI the offline package mirror for their air-gapped cluster has a missing libssl build (seen in preflight). I filed PR #482 to add a patched package. CC @Miriam for release window.
Miriam: saw PR, will merge on green. Can we avoid a hotfix by scoping the image to include the patch and re-run image bake? That takes ~3h.
Leo: Network team: cross-connect paperwork is approved, but we need the exact fiber/mod combo. ZenForge gave two part numbers; need validation of MPO vs LC. Waiting on vendor diagram.
Sam: @Aya can you escalate vendor diagram? If they don't have it today, we push cutover. Also who owns cert rotation for the private CA?
Aya: I pinged the vendor contact (tom@zenforge) and asked for a photo + part numbers. If they reply by noon we can keep the date. Cert rotation: @Devon owns CA cert plan for onprem bundles, right?
Devon: Yeah I have the rotation plan in the infra repo: `infra/zenforge/certs/README.md`. Steps: generate CSR onair, sign via customer-HSM, update kube secrets, restart controller. Need HSM access window.
Sam: HSM — ZenForge requested HSM via customer-managed HSM (YubiHSM). @Miriam do we have the integration docs ready?
Miriam: Integration doc is half done. I can finish by 1600 if @Devon can validate the signing commands. Also need approval to add HSM credentials to our secrets manager (we have an outstanding PO).
Devon: I validated commands, will drop a snippet in the PR. Example: ```bash
# sign CSR via yubihsm-shell
yubihsm-shell -a import wrapped-key -f key.blob
yubihsm-shell -a sign-ec -k 1234 -i csr.der -o signed.crt
```
Aya: infra-bot just posted that the ZenForge staging nodes passed kube-preflight yesterday but failed the package check due to missing `libssl1.1`. (infra-bot: summary attached)
infra-bot: build/zenforge-image: failed package check on 3/14, reason=missing libssl1.1, ticket=INF-813.
Leo: On the network front we can do MPO but vendor claims the rack has mixed LC jumpers. We need onsite photos to confirm patch-panel adapters. If adapters required, add +2 days.
Sam: Timeline decision: if vendor provides photos by noon -> proceed with cutover Thursday; otherwise we delay to next week. Can each owner post ETA in thread?
Aya: ETA for vendor diagram: 1200 PST (I will follow up).
Devon: ETA for PR merge + new image bake: 1800 PST today (image will be in our private registry `registry.redwood/zenforge:staged`).
Miriam: ETA for HSM doc + secrets approver: 1600 PST. Secrets approver is @Leo (need your OK for creds in Vault).
Leo: OK to add HSM creds to Vault path `secret/zenforge/hsm` as long as we put an ACL that disallows broad-read. I can approve after quick review, ETA 1500 PST.
Sam: Great. Two outstanding cross-team asks: (1) @ops-bot / oncall — can we reserve the maintenance window 02:00-05:00 UTC Friday? (2) @Aya please confirm vendor photo by noon.
ops-bot: Maintenance window requested: 2026-03-20 02:00-05:00 UTC, pending oncall acknowledgement.
Sam: final note: pushing a little checklist for cutover owner handoff — please react with :white_check_mark: when done and add any additional risks.
Devon: PR merged, image bake started :white_check_mark:
Miriam: HSM doc done, dropped link in infra PR :white_check_mark:
Leo: Vault ACLs reviewed, will create path and ping once done :eyes:
Aya: vendor sent photos at 11:47 PST, they show LC jumpers with adapter panels. This adds the +2 days. Summary: cannot cutover Thursday.
Sam: Thanks team. New plan: postpone to next Tue, update calendar invite, I will notify customer and ops. I’ll file a short retro on blockers after cutover.
Aya: noted, will update vendor timeline + confirm new PO timeline for cable adapters.
Sam: Closing thread for now — please keep updates here. :thumbsup:
